question: From 13 May 2025, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) mandated that digital lending apps must be _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**reported to a centralised portal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** has issued a directive requiring all **Regulated Entities (REs)**, which include **Commercial Banks**, **Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs)**, and **Cooperative Banks**, to report their **Digital Lending Apps (DLAs)** to a **centralised portal**.
 
• This regulation is mandated to be fully implemented by **13 May 2025**, aiming to create a structured and transparent digital credit market in **India**.
 
• The primary objective of this portal is to serve as a **verifiable repository** where customers can confirm the legitimacy of a lending app before engaging in financial transactions. ***Hence, the option "reported to a centralised portal" is correct.***
